classification.blocker: any rate-bound violation, start after abort, or a candidate-attributable increase in callbacks past maxWait
classification.confirmedRegression: paired CI entirely beyond the margin in the harmful direction (>= 5 reps) or single-rep difference beyond margin AND beyond A/A 95th-percentile noise, reproduced in a repeated cell
classification.suspectedRegression: point estimate beyond margin but CI or noise band overlaps

criteria.declaredBefore: any confirm/broad/... trial of the final harness was inspected (only smoke and instr validation stages had been seen)

margins.redisSavingsSignificant: calls/grant or Redis CPU us/grant reduced >= 20% with CI excluding 0

criteria.noiseReference: single-rep cells are judged against the empirical |aa-prod| distribution of the same metric across all cells of the same stage (95th percentile)
criteria.pairing: cand-prod and aa-prod differences per (cell, rep) with identical workload seeds; 95% t-interval and 4000-resample fixed-seed bootstrap on the paired mean
criteria.unchangedFromRound4: 1 utilization point, max(5ms,10%) p99, .02 Jain, 3 expired cohort jobs; none of these waive a regression
